method: Each installed CLI started fresh, wall time through exit and pipes drained. One process at a time, CPU affinity 2 inherited. Three warmup rounds and 21 measured rounds. Workload order and first arm rotated each round. Output tokens = gpt-tokenizer 3.4.0 o200k_base on the entire answer including its terminating newline. No model runs. TIDE projects inherit the repository tide.lock. CPython reference runs use -IBS in a temporary directory. The observed Python collector replays the example using setprofile and checks that the visited project functions are branch-free. The revision also covers the external Python examples.

record_controls.method: Current installed tide test. Same imported Ledger and Entry schemas and same posting module, a fresh process per case, rotating serial order on CPU 2. Root returns constant 0 for input-only controls, or its unchanged argument for identity controls. Input is the prefix of the ledger workload with the indicated count. The identity example also specifies those records as expected output.
